drinks-sommelier 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduced expert sommelier for beers and wines, focused on personalized suggestions based on user taste profiles.
- Distinguishes between beers and wines with dedicated taste sections and separate tracking of liked/disliked products.
- Requires user initialization: gathers and refines taste rules and product preferences before giving recommendations.
- Evaluates products through up-to-date web searches, never relying solely on built-in information.
- Provides scored recommendations with clear rationales, food pairings, and warnings for unsuitable products.
- Handles edge cases—such as insufficient information, unclear inputs, or unsatisfactory product selections—by prompting for clarification or reporting limitations.
